packageRules.description: Semver lets a 0.x minor or patch break. Renovate marks these breaking only under semver-style versioning, not loose or regex.
Default versioning never offers four-component PVP versions, and release tags carry a v that mise.toml omits.
Updates stay within each GHC reference's major series; new series arrive through the weekly matrix drift issue. Release tags wrap the version as ghc-X.Y.Z-release.
